rule_changes_2026.summary: Modifies alignment requirements for receiving team players in the setup zone on a kickoff or safety kick.
Modifies the dead ball spot after a touchback when the kickoff is from the 50-yard line (following 2025 touchback spot move to 35-yard line).
Permits the kicking team to declare an onside kick at any time during the game (removing trailing-only restriction from 2025); untouched beyond setup zone = 15-yd penalty.
Permits officials to consult with NFL Officiating staff on flagrant foul disqualifications.
